children: Gold prices remain supported as investors fret about U.S. fiscal issues, ANZ analysts write. Investors are buying gold as they seek protection from runaway budget deficits and a weaker dollar, they write. Investors will also have a close eye on the Jackson Hole meeting for any signals on the path of U.S. interest rates. In New York, gold futures trade flat at $4,666.20 a troy ounce.
